text.title: Is the four-day week here to stay?
paragraphs: When a group of British companies **trialled** a four-day week in 2022, few expected the results to be so striking. Of the 61 firms that took part, 56 decided to continue with the scheme once the six-month pilot had ended.

Employees reported lower levels of stress and burnout, while revenue remained broadly stable. Managers, however, admitted that the transition had required a **thorough** review of how meetings were organised.

Critics argue that the model cannot be applied to every industry. Hospitals and schools, they say, would struggle to comply with staffing requirements if working hours were cut. It is believed that around 15% of jobs could not be adapted at all.
Supporters remain **undeterred**. Had the pilot failed, they concede, the idea would probably have been shelved for a decade. Instead, it is now being discussed in parliaments across Europe.

grammar_notes.title: Third & mixed conditionals
grammar_notes.explanation:
Third: If + Past Perfect, would have + V3 — нереальное прошлое.
Mixed: If + Past Perfect, would + V1 — прошлое условие → результат сейчас.
Инверсия: Had the pilot failed… = If the pilot had failed…
Ловушка: НЕ используем would в части с if.
examples: Had the pilot failed, the idea would have been shelved.
If they had cut hours, hospitals would be understaffed now.

grammar_notes.title: Passive reporting structures
grammar_notes.explanation:
It is believed / said / thought that + clause
или Subject + is believed + to do / to have done.
examples: It is believed that 15% of jobs cannot be adapted.
The scheme is said to have improved well-being.
